summary: postgres_extra_settings under spec.database passes name/value pairs into postgresql.conf in the managed database pod, for example max_connections 1000; verify with oc exec <pod> -- psql -d gateway -c "SHOW max_connections;".
questions: How do I change max_connections for the AAP managed PostgreSQL?
Custom PostgreSQL settings on the AAP Operator

answer_card.title: Custom PostgreSQL settings
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
spec:
  database:
    postgres_extra_settings:
      - name: max_connections
        value: '1000'
```
Verify: `oc exec -it <aap postgres pod> -- psql -d gateway -c "SHOW max_connections;"`
